metadata.task_category: Data Structures - Range Maximum / Brute Force

prompt_text: Write a Python solution for the HackerRank problem Array Pairs.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution uses a nested loop resulting in O(n^2) complexity, which is too slow for constraints up to 100000 elements.
bug_analysis.root_cause: Brute-force approach without optimization for range maximum queries or pair counting.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Double nested loop over array indices
